chunks: Whatever is in it from Isma'il ibn Jabir, I have narrated it from Muhammad ibn Musa ibn al-Mutawakkil—may Allah be pleased with him—from Abdullah ibn Ja'far al-Himyari, from Muhammad ibn Isa, from Safwan ibn Yahya, from Isma'il ibn Jabir.

key_terms.إِسْمَاعِيلَ بْنِ جَابِرٍ: a narrator from whom reports are transmitted
key_terms.الْحِمْيَرِيِّ: the nisbah identifying Abdullah ibn Ja'far al-Himyari
key_terms.رَوَيْتُهُ: I transmitted it; the author’s statement of direct transmission
key_terms.فِي هَ: in it; referring to the book under discussion

ai.seo_question: What is the transmission chain to Isma'il ibn Jabir in Man La Yahduruhu al-Faqih?
ai.summary: This passage clarifies the sanad/isnad through which the author transmits reports from Isma'il ibn Jabir in Man La Yahduruhu al-Faqih. Its significance lies in documenting the route of transmission, which is essential in hadith sciences for identifying sources and evaluating narrations.
